newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritian rupee firmer against dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritian rupee firmer against dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against the dollar and pound on Friday, reflecting international trends, forex dealers said.

The rupee was fixed at a commercial bank mean rate of 20.4795 to the dollar from 20.497 on Thursday. The rupee was posted at a mean rate of 33.2245 to the pound from 33.2545 on Thursday, the dealers added.

Foreign exchange dealers said the rupee's fixing was done in line with the dollar's weakening in overnight foreign exchange markets. The Mauritius Sugar Syndicate made one tender sales of pounds on Friday morning.
"The inter-bank forex market is quiet for the moment as there is no big activity from importers," said one dealer.
